Omron to Acquire US Firm Onlogic for $675 Million

Japanese technology company Omron has announced its intention to acquire the US-based industrial PC firm Onlogic for $675 million. This acquisition is part of Omron's strategy to advance its capabilities in physical artificial intelligence (AI).
